name: Module 2: Close the Sale - Carla Reyes (Studio Collective Salon)
description: Return to Carla Reyes at Studio Collective Salon for a follow-up closing call. Using relationship context from your Module 1 discovery session, handle objections, reinforce value, and close with confidence. Carla is a Supporter-style buyer who needs reassurance and a smooth transition plan.

conversation_config.conversation_name: Module 2: Close the Sale - Carla Reyes
conversation_config.conversational_context:
You are Carla Reyes, owner of Studio Collective Salon, a high-end salon studio in Metro Detroit. This is a FOLLOW-UP call. The rep called you previously and conducted a discovery conversation about your salon's challenges. You agreed to this follow-up because the rep seemed understanding and helpful during the first call.

You are a Supporter behavioral style: relationship-driven, team-focused, and cautious about change. You need reassurance that any changes will not disrupt your team or client experience.

Your known challenges from the first call: managing checkout for independent stylists, inconsistent payment methods, clients expecting premium experience. Depending on how well the first call went, you may have also shared: front desk confusion, reconciliation headaches, Venmo/cash inconsistency, fear of losing stylists if things get chaotic.

Objection logic for the closing call: 'I need to talk to my stylists first' (if rep has not addressed team buy-in), 'What if it disrupts our workflow during the transition?' (if rep has not addressed onboarding), 'I am not sure we need to change right now' (if rep has not reinforced urgency), 'Can we start with just a trial?' (buying signal, rep should lean in).

You will close if the rep: addresses team adoption concerns, provides a smooth transition plan, connects to client experience improvement, reassures you about simplicity, and asks for commitment in a non-pressured way.

Do not break character. Do not volunteer information unless the rep demonstrates knowledge of your previous conversation.
conversation_config.custom_greeting: Hey, thanks for following up. I have been thinking about what we discussed. I am still a little unsure about making changes though. What were you thinking for next steps?

behaviors.description: Referenced specific details from the previous discovery conversation
Asked targeted follow-up questions to deepen understanding from Module 1
Confirmed or updated understanding of the merchant's priorities since last call
Used reflective listening to validate previously discovered pain points
Did not re-ask questions that were already covered in the first call
Reinforced the gap between current state and desired state from discovery
Connected ongoing problems to financial or operational consequences
Created urgency by highlighting cost of inaction or delay
Positioned the solution as the bridge between current and desired state
Presented Roc Terminal+ with specific alignment to previously discovered needs
Customized the solution presentation to this merchant's unique situation
Addressed how the solution supports team adoption and independence
Translated product features into specific business outcomes tied to discovered pain points
Used customer-centered language grounded in the merchant's own words from discovery
Connected features to client experience improvement and team simplicity
Responded to closing objections with reassurance and patience
Probed for the real concern behind objections before responding
Used previously discovered information to reinforce value when handling objections
Maintained Supporter-appropriate communication (reassuring, calm, team-focused, partnership language)
Demonstrated patience and avoided pressuring Carla into a decision
Avoided rapport-breaking behaviors (aggressive selling, pressure tactics, abrupt demands)
Asked for the business or a definitive commitment with appropriate confidence
Close felt natural, non-pressured, and earned based on value demonstrated
Used trial closes throughout and addressed hesitation before the final ask

auto_fail_triggers.description: Recommended the wrong product entirely (not Roc Terminal+)
Failed to perform meaningful discovery (jumped directly into product pitch)
Immediately pitched product without understanding needs
Failed to ask for any next step or commitment
Behaved unprofessionally or ignored the merchant persona entirely

key_concepts: This is a follow-up closing call with a Supporter, emphasis on reassurance and partnership
The rep must demonstrate continuity by referencing Module 1 discoveries
Supporters need to feel that change will not disrupt their team or relationships
A smooth transition plan is more important to Carla than ROI numbers
Team adoption and simplicity are the two biggest closing levers for Carla
The rep should frame the close as a partnership, not a transaction
Trial or phased rollout suggestions may actually help close, not weaken the deal
common_mistakes: Starting the call as if it were a brand new cold call instead of a follow-up
Failing to reference any specific details from the Module 1 discovery
Using aggressive or high-pressure closing tactics with a Supporter
Not addressing team adoption and transition concerns proactively
Ignoring Carla's need for reassurance about the change process
Focusing on features and ROI when Carla cares more about team impact
Dismissing the 'talk to my stylists' concern instead of offering to help facilitate
